title: Bonn Place Brewing Company
gap: Price range for beers on tap not stated
blurb: Bonn Place Brewing Company is a quaint brewery in the SouthSide of Bethlehem. They offer a variety of beers including award-winning brews, cocktails, espresso drinks, and soft drinks. Guests can enjoy beer on tap, cans and bottles to-go, and participate in events like Bring Your Own Vinyl Fridays and a loyalty program.
